wireContract.wireLong: existing Yudao conditional JSON number/string Long serialization
wireContract.errorEnvelope: existing CUT CommonResult and controller-local HTTP mapping

exportChecklist.projection: only applicable BUSINESS_SURVEY and RISK rows from the same authorized checklist detail projection; DUAL_MACHINE_CHECK and every other item type are excluded
exportChecklist.sideEffects: platform operation audit only; no persistent export artifact and no CUT business row insert/update/version touch

submitExtension.base: F-CUT-003 submit request, headers, idempotency, guards and ChecklistCommandResult
submitExtension.fieldType: NavigationDecision; never null after a successful checklist submit
submitExtension.businessResult: always the existing SUBMITTED checklist and PLAN_DRAFTING task before navigation is evaluated

configurationExtension.addedField: navigationRule in the existing complete configuration request and CutoverConfigurationRespVO
configurationExtension.create: POST /cutover-config/revisions keeps CommonResult<WireLong>; the existing complete create request adds required exact key navigationRule with NavigationRule OR JSON null
configurationExtension.saveDraft: PUT /cutover-config/revisions/{revisionId} keeps If-Match and CommonResult<Boolean>; the existing complete request adds required exact key navigationRule with NavigationRule OR JSON null
configurationExtension.detail: GET /cutover-config/revisions/{revisionId} keeps CommonResult<CutoverConfigurationRespVO>; response adds navigationRule with the stored NavigationRule OR JSON null
configurationExtension.copy: POST /cutover-config/revisions/{revisionId}/actions/copy keeps If-Match, no request body and CommonResult<WireLong>; copied value is verified by GET of the returned revisionId
configurationExtension.validate: keeps CommonResult<CutoverConfigurationValidationRespVO>; unknown target or any condition/list/priority/state field is reported at navigationRule or navigationRule.target
configurationExtension.publish: keeps If-Match and CommonResult<CutoverConfigurationRespVO>; response adds the unchanged stored navigationRule
configurationExtension.disable: keeps If-Match and CommonResult<CutoverConfigurationRespVO>; response adds the unchanged stored navigationRule

fields.configurationRevisionId: positive WireLong equal to the task-frozen revision

NavigationRule.semantics: one unconditional post-submit UI target; no condition, priority, list, state or action field

NavigationTarget.CURRENT_STAGE_WORKBENCH: navigate to the authoritative P4 workbench after submit
NavigationTarget.TASK_OVERVIEW: navigate to the cutover task overview

rowOrder: sortOrder ASC with null treated as 0

columns.type: positive Integer starting at 1 within each sheet
text; itemDescription; null is empty cell
text; AuthorizedAnswerDisplay; null currentResult is empty cell
text; currentResult.factDescription; null is empty cell
text enum 人工附件已关联,采集结果已关联,empty; never contains reference keys or ids

AuthorizedAnswerDisplay.DIRECT: the authorized currentResult.answerSnapshot is emitted exactly as an XLSX text cell, never as a formula; null is empty cell
AuthorizedAnswerDisplay.MANUAL: constant 人工结果已提交; answerSnapshot and every artifactId/referenceKey/fileFactVersion/scopeVersion/sha256 are forbidden
AuthorizedAnswerDisplay.COLLECTION: constant 采集结果已形成; answerSnapshot, collectionTaskId and collectionResultReferenceId/version are forbidden
AuthorizedAnswerDisplay.EXTERNAL: constant 外部结果已形成; answerSnapshot and every external raw response/identity are forbidden
AuthorizedAnswerDisplay.unknownSource: fail with EXPORT_PROJECTION_INVALID; never fall back to raw answerSnapshot

strictBoundary: unknown or extra request keys fail closed; export never falls back to another checklist version or unfiltered projection
